_doc: Battle presentation and battle audio that stay the same in every era (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md, areas 'Tempo, Animation und Praesentation' and 'Audio im Kampf'). Read by scripts/battle/presenter/BattleShow.gd and BattleAudio.gd. crit_hitstop: freeze in seconds for a keen hit. phase_zoom: per era, a hard whole-number zoom on the boss when its phase turns (0 = none; Era IV/V keep their own camera). banner_time: seconds a show banner stays (scaled by the battle speed); banner_read: it never stays less than min plus per_char seconds for each letter, at any speed (items 899, 900). status_motes: per status the mote shape (spark, drop, leaf, zig, ring, z, chain), drift (-1 up, 1 down, 2 still links round the feet), count and colour from Era II on; Era I and high contrast draw them in ink. aura: stage aura colours (up, down) from Era II on and the ring's dot count. lantern: the warm light at the feet of a Spirling that steps out (alpha, time). victory_glints: glints of the winners' pose per era. night: share of the day/night tint the backdrop takes, and backdrops that never get it. quick_intro: share of the intro time a rematch keeps. audio: battle sounds (see BattleAudio.gd). boss_size: per era the size in pixels a lone Rift boss stands at in the formation (0 = its slot; Era IV/V keep their stage). boss_motion: how much bigger a lone Rift boss winds up, lunges and is knocked back (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 item 423; reduced motion keeps its 1 px jolt). boss_short_speed: from this battle speed on a Rift boss keeps only the short opening and one short entrance line with its name on the tag (item 424). outro: seconds the end-of-battle report card stays (scaled by the battle speed, a tap closes it). fx_budget: element effects redraw at most fps times a second on a phone or in battery saver (0 = every frame) and draw at most max_particles particles of one kind. damage_numbers: rise in pixels and time of the optional damage numbers (white with an ink rim). energy_pips: seconds a gained Energy pip pops and a spent one fades. audio.field_ambience: the ambience loop under each Resonance field; audio.text_duck_db: how far the music dips while a battle line types; audio.themes: battle music for night, festival, Weekly Echo, tower and online duels.
